name: 32308 · Tallahassee, FL
findings: ZIP 32308 (Tallahassee) has 267 nonprofit organizations. 108 of them (40%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 91 organizations.
Health care organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (16% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 32308 (Tallahassee) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: More organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 32308 (Tallahassee) list membership on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 3.2 times the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 91 organizations here; 34% of all organizations here have no identified type.
